direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the inspector evidence rows and stage node labels to 11px minimum; refit the opening-story logo panel so its caption does not compete with the 120 versus 80 mismatch tracks.
Link ev-cert-qty and ev-recv-qty hovering, focus and selection bidirectionally between SVG and inspector rows with matching outline and text marker.
Reduce the right-panel metric repetition: keep 2 impacted jobs, 70 units and 3 feasible paths once, then give the freed height to source evidence.

Keep Route health pre-flight and Investigation source evidence as separate labelled regions; add distinct nonce and identity status lines inside pre-flight without merging them into the investigation control.
Give the route selector a visible label, 40px target and focus ring; state offline/no-network beside it so the Sample choice is deliberate.
Move the Britt 4.0 strip into the stage footer at one line so the factory SVG gains vertical room at 1366x768.
Preserve the selected-path opening of the typed consent form; add exact-phrase progress as text, keep Accept disabled until matched, and announce the match state via aria-live polite.
Align the three option cards on finish and incremental cost columns and enlarge the radio targets to at least 36px without changing trade-off values.
Shorten the plan identifier line and let its full value appear on focus or in the inspector details, reducing wrapped microcopy in the consent panel.
Make the three proposed tasks explicitly untracked until approval in each card header, not only in the group banner, and keep Decline and Approve actions visually separated.
On the stage, label the 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 flows at 11px and ensure their combined 70-unit callout reads as one accepted plan.
Refit the right task list so t3 and End of proposal are visible without relying on the thin internal scrollbar at 768px height.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2: dashed silver preview outline plus WILL GO OFFLINE text, reserving solid stoppedRed until the shock is applied.
Place the invalidation consequence directly beside the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar centre status before Apply second shock is pressed.
Dim the Scenario management admin action as secondary text control with a focus ring, keeping the single neon primary for the shock action.
Keep stoppedRed confined to CELL-MILL-2 cross-hatch, outline and OFFLINE-STOPPED label; verify no route line enters that cell and the constrained Split card stays hatched silver.
Retain the separate pre-flight nonce/identity route-health region above the distinct Investigation region, with its own status and no shared button.
Enlarge the CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE banner and the 3 to 2 feasible paths note to 11px minimum and align it with the mismatch tracks.

Preserve typed consent for the revised plan; show Scenario changed, prior acceptance invalidated and fresh review required above the input, with Accept revised decision disabled until the exact phrase matches.
For the constrained Split option, keep finish and cost shown as em dashes with the reason at least two online compatible cells are required, using hatch plus text rather than color alone.
Tighten the comparison cards so the full Human Decision panel fits without crowding the input at 1366x768.

Keep blocked prior tasks and the approved revised plan visibly coexisting with replacement tasks awaiting approval; label the prior group 3 BLOCKED and the new group PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL with equal clarity.
Refit the inspector list so all replacement task cards and Decline proposal are reachable by keyboard in order, with the internal scroll region named and focus visible.
On stage, keep red only on CELL-MILL-2 and add a text marker on the CELL-MILL-1 recovery flow showing 40 plus 30 equals 70 units.

Sequence the inspector as numbered Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet and Retain independent checkpoint steps, disabling each next control until the prior step completes and explaining state in text.
Enlarge the passphrase guidance and input label, show 16-160 character and word/type requirements as a checklist, and keep the separate-passphrase warning adjacent to the field.
Compress the Before-After metrics row so the three proof actions fit above the fold in the inspector without internal scrolling hiding step 3.
Add a clear completion status in the rail and DecisionBar: Packet sealed, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained, matching the stage footer text.
Make the disabled Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint controls read as Complete with check markers and current ledger text, not as inactive actions awaiting input.
Provide one secondary action in the inspector to review retained evidence, keeping Back as the only DecisionBar control and no new primary.
